name: popsicle
headline: short-video-factory: Effortless Video Creation
short_description: Automatically generate and edit short videos for marketing. Ideal for product promotion and content creation. Connects to desktop tools for cross-platform use.
author: YILS-LIN

sections.overview:
The short-video-factory skill is a powerful tool designed for marketers and content creators who need to generate high-quality promotional videos quickly and efficiently. This Claude Code skill leverages AI to automate the video editing process, allowing users to create visually appealing short videos for product marketing and general content with just one click. By utilizing AI-driven scripts and visuals, this skill streamlines the video production process, making it accessible even for beginners. One of the key benefits of the short-video-factory skill is the significant time savings it offers. Users can implement this skill in just 30 minutes, making it an ideal solution for busy professionals who need to produce engaging video content without the hassle of traditional editing methods. With this skill, users can batch process multiple video clips, ensuring a cohesive and polished final product that is ready for social media campaigns or product launches. This skill is particularly beneficial for marketers, product managers, and AI practitioners who are looking to enhance their content strategy. It allows for the creation of personalized video content tailored to specific audiences by simply inputting targeted keywords. For example, a product manager can quickly generate a promotional video for a new product launch or a marketer can automate the editing of video clips for an upcoming event, maximizing their efficiency and resource management. The implementation of the short-video-factory skill is straightforward, with a difficulty level rated as beginner. Users do not require advanced technical skills to get started, making it an excellent addition to any AI-first workflow. By integrating this skill into their marketing strategies, professionals can not only save time but also elevate their content creation efforts, ensuring they stay competitive in a fast-paced digital landscape.
Quickly generate promotional videos for new products using AI-driven scripts and visuals.
Automate the editing process for multiple video clips to create cohesive content for social media campaigns.
Produce engaging short videos with voiceovers and subtitles for marketing purposes.
Create personalized video content tailored to specific audiences by inputting targeted keywords.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/YILS-LIN/short-video-factory`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 30-second promotional video for [PRODUCT] targeting [AUDIENCE]. Use the following key points: [KEY POINTS]. Include dynamic transitions, on-screen text, and background music. Export in 1080p resolution for [PLATFORM] (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts).
```
Copy

```
Here's a 30-second promotional video script and description for a fictional fitness app called 'FitFlow' targeting young professionals:

[Opening shot: A busy office worker looking stressed]
[On-screen text: 'Stressed? Overwhelmed?']
[Voiceover: 'Meet FitFlow - your pocket-sized fitness coach.']

[Quick cuts: App interface showing personalized workouts]
[On-screen text: 'Personalized workouts']
[Voiceover: 'Get workouts tailored to your schedule and fitness level.']

[Montage: People doing quick desk exercises]
[On-screen text: 'Micro-workouts']
[Voiceover: 'Sneak in quick workouts between meetings.']

[Closing shot: FitFlow app logo with download button]
[Voiceover: 'Download FitFlow today and start your fitness journey.']

Background music: Upbeat electronic track. Export format: 1080p MP4 for Instagram Reels.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
